text:
Maria K: We keep seeing action items from postmortems drift without clear owners or dates. Proposal: a recurring 15m "postmortem follow-up" standup to go over open remediation items, owners, and short blockers. Goal: reduce overdue items and spot recurring patterns. Thoughts?

Jamal R: Love it. Is 15m enough? Who should be required to attend?

Maria K: I think 15m is fine if we keep it strictly to status (owner, ETA, blocker). Required: the remediation owner + oncall lead + PM/FE/infra owner as relevant. Optional: others can join.

Alex T: Suggestion: do weekly 15m for tactical follow-ups, plus a monthly 30m "incident trends" review where we look at recurring patterns and SLO impact. That keeps the weekly focused.

Sara L: Agree with Alex. Also propose a lightweight "owner matrix" in the postmortem tracker: columns = Owner, Due date, Blocker, Risk (P0/P1), Remediation type (infra/process/code). Example header: `owner,due_date,blocker,risk,remediation_type,verifier`

Nidhi (oncall): Practical items from oncall perspective: automations to remind owners 48h before due date, and an action resolution checklist so QA/verifier can mark done. Right now items vanish from the board.

Maria K: Good call. I can add a "reminder" workflow that pings owners in #eng-oncall and creates an incident-bot reminder. Also propose we require an explicit verifier for every item.

Jamal R: For rotation — can we make the incident commander rotation own facilitation of the weekly follow-up for their rotation week? They'd just run the 15m and update the tracker. Low lift.

Alex T: That helps share load. Add-runbook step: incident commander opens the weekly checklist (template I'll draft) and files any missing owners.

Sara L: Comms cadence: after we close an action, do we want a short note in the original postmortem thread summarizing closure and verifier? That makes audits easier.

Maria K: Yes. Workflow idea: when verifier marks item done, incident-bot posts: `Action closed: <item id> by <owner> verified by <verifier>` in the PM thread and tags @escalation-list.

Nidhi (oncall): One more: recurring incident patterns — can the monthly trends include a small heatmap of incident types by week and top 3 recurring fixes? That will help prioritize systemic remediation.

Alex T: I'll prototype a simple query against the incident tracker to produce monthly counts and top recurring remediation tags. Could be attached in the monthly deck.

Maria K: OK concrete next steps: 1) Alex drafts weekly checklist + monthly trend query (due EOD Wed). 2) Maria wires a reminder via incidents-bot and adds verifier column to tracker (due Fri). 3) Nidhi prototypes the reminders flow on the staging bot (ping me when ready). 4) Jamal to coordinate IC rotation assignment (list of volunteers below).

Jamal R: Volunteers for facilitating weekly follow-ups (IC rotation weeks): Jamal, Nidhi, Alex, Sara — I'm fine to start.

Sara L: :thumbsup: Also propose we keep follow-up notes to max 3 bullets per item in the weekly meeting to keep it quick.

Maria K: Agreed. If anyone objects to the plan, shout now. Otherwise I'll schedule a recurring 15m Monday standup and add agenda + template to the tracker.

Nidhi (oncall): No objections. I'll test the reminder flow tomorrow and post logs in this thread.

Alex T: I'll drop the initial checklist and a sample query link: https://go/reports/incident-trends-sample (proto)

Jamal R: Thanks all. Quick Q: can we automatically mark items stale after 90d and escalate to eng leads?

Maria K: Yes — add stale policy: 90d -> auto-flag and email leads. We should avoid auto-closure without verification.

incidents-bot: Reminder created: weekly "Postmortem follow-up" on Mondays 09:15-09:30. Tracker updated with new columns: owner, verifier, due_date, reminder.

Sara L: Nice. If the bot can post a short agenda 30m before the meeting that'd be helpful.

Maria K: I'll add a pre-standup agenda post, and a template checklist in the tracker. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with invites and the template links.

Jamal R: :+1:

Nidhi (oncall): I'll post the reminder flow results here once validated.

Alex T: Will put the monthly trend prototype in the shared drive by Friday.

Maria K: End of thread: scheduling invites + templates incoming.
